description: This file contains asynchronous functions to interact with RoleAdjacency data using SQLAlchemy ORM, including retrieval, listing, and creation of role adjacency records within a database session.

methods.name: Optional[RoleAdjacency] get_role_adjacency(session: AsyncSession, source_role_id: str, target_role_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a RoleAdjacency record between source and target roles, or returns None if not found.

methods.name: List[RoleAdjacency] list_outgoing_role_adjacencies(session: AsyncSession, role_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all RoleAdjacency records where the specified role is the source.

methods.name: List[RoleAdjacency] list_incoming_role_adjacencies(session: AsyncSession, role_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all RoleAdjacency records where the specified role is the target.

methods.name: List[RoleAdjacency] list_role_adjacencies_bidirectional(session: AsyncSession, role_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all RoleAdjacency records that involve the specified role in either source or target.

methods.name: RoleAdjacency create_role_adjacency(session: AsyncSession, payload: RoleAdjacencyCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new RoleAdjacency record, raising an error if a duplicate for the same source and target exists.
